notes: Actor is NOT hard-coded. Set APIFY_ACTOR_ID or pass --actor-id.
Adjust actor_input_template keys to match the chosen Actor docs (startUrls vs groupUrls, etc.).
If the Actor needs Facebook cookies for closed groups, put JSON cookies in Apify secret storage or FACEBOOK_COOKIES_JSON env — never in this file, git, DB, or logs.
Public groups may work without cookies depending on the Actor.
